tasks.name: code-context-and-delimiters
tasks.evidence: Fenced code precedence, zero-height delimiters, safe generated fences and literal HTML PRE are tested. Top-level indented code with internal blank rows and CRLF Enter now passes both Linux engines. Nested/container code contexts and remaining keyboard semantics are still pending.

tasks.name: common-markdown-and-mapping
tasks.evidence: List hanging indent, physical/task/tab continuations and quote depth/continuity pass on both Linux engines. Table separator scanning shares escape/code context. Inline tokenizer covers escapes, variable-width code, underscore/nested emphasis, strikethrough and inline links. All current projected text and DOM boundaries use explicit row-relative source intervals; native Select All includes hidden prefixes. Full Linux suite and classic regressions passed with explicit Xvfb rendering fallback. Setext titles and closed initial front matter now pass native Linux opening/edit/undo/mode probes. Reference links, autolinks, images, nested/container code and remaining block/unsupported-literal contexts still pending.

tasks.name: enter-tab-and-local-cleanup
tasks.evidence: Tab/Shift+Tab in both modes preserves mixed terminators, list subtrees and oriented selections, with undo/redo. Visual prose Enter now generates one local hard-break marker, hides its syntax, removes owned markers for paragraph creation/Backspace joins and protects literal escaping or explicitly retyped source. Provenance survives row indentation. Full Linux suite and eleven isolated regression scripts passed. Structure-transition cleanup, remaining boundary operations, general gesture planning and actual recovery persistence are still pending. Forward Delete now joins owned boundaries atomically with undo/provenance restoration, including mixed terminators and literal escaping; full Linux suite and eleven regressions passed. Structural transitions after an owned boundary now remove the redundant marker in the same transaction, with manual-marker preservation and undo restoration. Cleanup within larger transformed units and recovery integration remain pending.

tasks.name: clipboard
tasks.evidence: HTML PRE preserves literal text, whitespace and safe fences; internal clipboard and the remaining HTML structures are pending.

tasks.name: file-actions-recovery-and-windows
tasks.evidence: Separate leased recovery records for concurrent same-path sessions and untitled documents; explicit same-document selection, own-copy discard/save, exact legacy import receipts and retained originals. Native Linux crash/restart, choice/cancel, early Save and migration probes, final full Linux suite, eleven editor regressions and thirteen Rust checks on all three platforms passed. File actions, cross-document recovery UI and changed-base recovery remain pending. Shared canonical-path locks now protect saves, including occupied temporary slots, absent/deleted destinations and other-instance conflicts. Blocking I/O is off the UI thread; a captured save leaves newer edits dirty, with recovery persisted during lock wait and rebased after commit. Obsolete document context commands are rejected. New/Open now stage file validation and recovery choices before replacing context, with Save/Discard/Cancel, fresh untitled sessions and history reset on successful Open. Rust checks on all platforms and the full 31-requirement Linux suite pass, including actual menu visibility, shortcuts, recovery-choice cancellation and unrelated-copy preservation.

tasks.name: bug-build-identity-and-review-runner
tasks.evidence: Concurrent Bug append uses the shared filesystem lock and preserves truncated original tails before the next full record. Build identity, immutable Bug capture enhancements and the per-version review runner remain pending.
